installCommand: curl -sLJO https://github.com/sass/dart-sass/releases/download/1.104.0/dart-sass-1.104.0-linux-x64.tar.gz && tar -xf dart-sass-1.104.0-linux-x64.tar.gz && mv dart-sass bin && rm -f dart-sass-1.104.0-linux-x64.tar.gz && npm ci
buildCommand: export PATH=$PWD/bin:$PATH && hugo --gc --minify && if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "production" ] && [ -n "$ALGOLIA_APP_ID" ]; then ALGOLIA_INDEX_NAME=index.en ALGOLIA_INDEX_FILE=./public/search.json npm run algolia && ALGOLIA_INDEX_NAME=index.zh-cn ALGOLIA_INDEX_FILE=./public/zh/search.json npm run algolia; else echo '[algolia] skip index sync (not production or ALGOLIA_APP_ID unset)'; fi
